About the studio

Technology should make the next move feel obvious.

Tech Buzzs is an independent development studio for teams with ambitious software problems. We combine product-minded interface work with the systems thinking needed to make it dependable in production.

How we work

We stay close to the problem: clarify the useful outcome, make pragmatic technical choices, build the right slice, and keep the path to production visible. The result is software that is legible to its users and maintainers alike.

Principles

  • Build with intentEvery feature earns its place.
  • Prefer durable simplicityClear systems outlast clever ones.
  • Leave room to growToday’s release should not block tomorrow’s work.
